name: 能量（效率/回收/节能）评估

map.计算液压泵容积效率、机械效率与总效率，评估势能回收率与变频节能效果，输入参数自动: Computes hydraulic pump volumetric, mechanical, and total efficiency; assesses potential-energy recovery and VFD energy savings; auto-calculates from inputs and gives savings suggestions.
map.容积效率 ηv = 实际流量 qa ÷ 理论流量 qt × 100%；机械效率: Volumetric efficiency \u03b7v = actual flow qa \u00f7 theoretical flow qt \u00d7 100%; mechanical efficiency \u03b7m = theoretical input torque Tt \u00f7 actual input torque Ta \u00d7 100%; total efficiency \u03b7 = \u03b7v \u00d7 \u03b7m; potential energy Ep = m\u00b7g\u00b7h (J); total power P = Ep \u00f7 t \u00f7 1000 (kW); recovered power Pr = P \u00d7 \u03b7R; loss power = P \u2212 Pr; VFD saving = P\u00b7t\u00b7saving rate.
map.液压泵效率由容积效率与机械效率相乘得到：容积效率反映内泄漏（实际流量与理论流量之: Pump efficiency = volumetric \u00d7 mechanical. Volumetric reflects internal leakage (actual/theoretical flow); mechanical reflects friction loss (theoretical/actual torque); total efficiency below 70% is low. Energy recovery: potential energy Ep=mgh from load mass and drop height, divided by action time gives power, multiplied by recovery efficiency gives recoverable power. VFD savings: fixed-frequency daily consumption \u00d7 saving rate estimates daily/yearly savings and CO\u2082 reduction (factor 0.785 kg CO\u2082/kWh).
map.容积效率 ηv = qa/qt；机械效率 ηm = Tt/Ta；总效率 η =: Volumetric efficiency \u03b7v = qa/qt; mechanical efficiency \u03b7m = Tt/Ta; total efficiency \u03b7 = \u03b7v \u00d7 \u03b7m
map.势能 Ep = m×g×h；可回收功率 Pr = Ep×ηr/t；g=9.81: Potential energy Ep = m\u00d7g\u00d7h; recoverable power Pr = Ep\u00d7\u03b7r/t; g=9.81 m/s\u00b2
map.定频日耗电 = P×t；变频日耗电 = 定频×(1-节能率)；电费按 1.0 元: Fixed-frequency daily consumption = P\u00d7t; VFD daily = fixed \u00d7 (1 \u2212 saving rate); electricity cost estimated at 1.0 yuan/kWh
map.容积效率反映泄漏程度，正常应 >90%，低于 85% 需检修: Volumetric efficiency reflects leakage; normally >90%, below 85% needs service
map.机械效率反映摩擦损失，正常应 >90%: Mechanical efficiency reflects friction loss; normally >90%
map.总效率 = 容积效率 × 机械效率，液压泵总效率一般 75%-90%: Total efficiency = volumetric \u00d7 mechanical; pump total efficiency is generally 75%\u201390%
map.能量回收适用于挖掘机、起重机等有重力势能变化的设备: Energy recovery suits excavators, cranes, and other equipment with gravitational potential-energy changes
map.与有效液压功率算系统效率。: and effective hydraulic power to compute system efficiency.
map.识别溢流损失、节流损失等节能改造点。: Identify energy-saving retrofit points such as overflow and throttling losses.
map.对比变量泵与定量泵方案的全周期能耗。: Compare full-life energy use of variable- vs fixed-displacement pump schemes.
map.输入 100 kW、有效输出 92 kW、利用率 80% → 系统效率 = 92: Input 100 kW, effective output 92 kW, utilization 80%
map.改造潜力: System efficiency = 92\u00d70.8\u00f7100 = 73.6%; the rest is mostly overflow and throttling heat loss.
map.效率低的常见原因？: Replacing fixed with variable pump can cut overflow loss ~15%; annual saving is significant by operating hours.
map.怎么测有效功率？: Constantly open relief valve, throttling speed control, and oversized pump are the three main heat-loss sources; address these first.
map.关于「液压系统能量效率评估」: Effective power = system pressure \u00d7 actual flow; ratio to grid input power gives system efficiency.
map.容积效率/机械效率/总效率一键计算: The hydraulic system energy-efficiency assessment tool supports three modules: system efficiency (volumetric/mechanical/total), potential-energy recovery, and VFD savings comparison, helping engineers quantify energy use and plan savings.
